assets.prompt: Create a production game UI WINDOW BORDER asset, landscape 4:3 rectangle. Hand-painted 2D Thai Ayothaya fantasy MMORPG art matching antique gold lotus and deep jade-green old-school RPG menus. Four restrained gold lotus corner ornaments, fine carved twin gold rails along the four edges, one tiny crossed-sword jewel accent at the middle of the top edge. No title plate. Huge EMPTY fully TRANSPARENT inner opening, at least 85% of width and height. Outer background fully transparent too. Exactly one perfectly straight symmetrical rectangular frame, all four sides visible with comfortable outer padding, flat front view, crisp opaque gold edges, subtle painted highlights, no perspective. This will be sliced into stretchable corners and edges so keep long edge middles simple. No text, letters, numbers, icons inside the opening, scenic artwork, shadows outside, glow, photorealism or glossy 3D. Clean restrained painted game craftsmanship.
assets.edit: Edit this game UI border asset for production nine-slice scaling. Preserve the existing lotus CORNER ornaments, the top-left envelope if present, gold/jade palette and the transparent centre and outer background. REMOVE every ornament or emblem at the MIDDLE of every edge: remove the central crossed swords, central top diamond, bottom central diamond and left/right midpoint diamonds, replacing each with the same uninterrupted straight gold-and-jade rail as the adjoining edge. ONLY the four corners may contain decorative flourishes. Make the middle stretches of all four edges simple straight constant-width rails. Keep the original rectangle, front view, hand-painted quality, alpha transparency and empty centre. No text and no other changes.
